system.name: Perspect
system.one_liner: a relational-debugging tool that pinpoints root causes of performance problems by comparing good and bad program executions

components.name: Input
components.role: provides the good_run/bad_run scripts plus the symptom instructions that seed the analysis

components.name: ./good_run
components.role: script that reproduces a normal (non-symptomatic) execution

components.name: ./bad_run
components.role: script that reproduces the symptomatic execution

components.name: Symptom
components.role: instructions (insn 1...m) identified as related to the observed symptom, the starting points of the analysis

components.name: Perspect
components.role: the overall relational-debugging system comprising static/dynamic causality analysis and the relational debugger

components.name: Dyninst
components.role: dynamic binary instrumentation tool supporting the static causality analysis stage

components.name: Static causality analysis
components.role: identifies instructions related to the input symptom to narrow the analysis search space

components.name: RR
components.role: record-and-replay tool feeding recorded runtime instances into the static causality analysis

components.name: Dynamic causality analysis
components.role: further reduces the search space to instructions and runtime instances causally related to the symptom

components.name: PIN
components.role: dynamic binary instrumentation tool supporting the dynamic causality analysis stage

components.name: Relational debugger
components.role: builds, filters, refines and ranks relations between symptom instructions and their causal predecessors

components.name: Compute
components.role: computes relations between symptom instructions and their causal predecessors from runtime dependencies

components.name: Filter
components.role: filters out relations unchanged between the good and bad executions

components.name: Refine
components.role: refines each relation until it captures a specific root cause of the symptom change

components.name: Output
components.role: the ranked list of candidate root-cause relations Perspect produces

components.name: Ranked list
components.role: root-cause candidate relations (Relation 1...n) ranked by their impact on the observed symptom

content.key_idea: Perspect narrows a symptom to causally related instructions via static and dynamic causality analysis, then iteratively computes, filters, and refines relations until a small ranked list of root-cause candidates remains.
content.reading_order: Left to right: Input (good/bad runs, symptom instructions) through Static then Dynamic causality analysis into the Relational debugger's compute-filter-refine loop, ending at the ranked Output list.

evidence: Perspect uses causality analysis to reduce the search space of relational debugging to a small set of instructions
It filters out relations that are irrelevant to the symptom, refines relations to be specific to the root cause
The filtering and refinement steps are iterated repeatedly to select a minimal set of relations

summary: This figure gives an overview of Perspect's workflow for relational debugging. Perspect takes as input a good_run and a bad_run script plus a symptom, a set of instructions (insn 1...m) suspected of recording the performance problem. A Static causality analysis stage, aided by Dyninst and a record-replay tool (RR), and a Dynamic causality analysis stage, aided by PIN, together narrow the search to instructions and runtime instances causally related to the symptom. The Relational debugger then loops through Compute, Filter, and Refine stages: it computes relations between symptom instructions and their causal predecessors, filters out relations unchanged between the good and bad executions, and refines the remaining ones until each captures a specific root cause, iterating until a minimal set remains. Perspect finally ranks these candidate relations by their impact on the symptom and outputs them as a Ranked list (Relation 1...n).
summary_zh: 该图展示 Perspect 的调试工作流：输入好/坏运行及症状指令；经静态与动态因果分析缩小范围后，由关系调试器循环计算-过滤-精化，按影响排序输出候选根因列表。
